title: C24/4/2019 of SMT. DEEPIKA RAWAT Vs VINOD KUMAR RAWAT

paras.text:
C-24 No. 04 of 2019
Hon'ble Alok Singh, J.
Mr. M. S. Bisht, Advocate for the
applicant-wife.
By means of present application filed
by the applicant under Section 24 of the Code
of Civil Procedure, the applicant seeks to
transfer the proceedings of Matrimonial Case
No.03 of 2019, titled as, Vinod Kumar vs
Deepika Rawat, under section 9 of the Hindu
Marriage Act, 1955, pending before the Family
Judge, Pauri Garhwal, District Pauri Garhwal
to the competent court of Kotdwar, District
Pauri Garhwal.
Heard learned counsel for the
applicant.
Learned counsel for the applicant
submits that applicant-wife is residing in
Kotdwar. Respondent-husband is also
harassing the applicant-wife for bringing
insufficient dowry and ousted the applicant-wife from her matrimonial house, even though
the respondent is not paying any maintenance
to the applicant.
Considering the facts and
circumstances of the case and also in view of
the law laid down by the Supreme Court in
Bhartiben Ravibhai Rav vs. Ravibhai
Govindbhai Rav, (2017) 6 SCC 785, Vaishali
Shridhar Jagtap vs. Shridhar Vishwanath
Jagtap, (2016) 14 SCC 356 and Sumita
Singh vs. Kumar Sanjay & another, AIR
2002 SC 396, the Matrimonial Case No.03 of
2019, titled as, Vinod Kumar vs Deepika
Rawat, under section 9 of the Hindu Marriage
Act, 1955 is transferred to the competent court
of Kotdwar, District Pauri Garhwal.
Let the record of the aforesaid case be
transferred to the competent court of Kotdwar,
District Pauri Garhwal, within one month from
today.
The petition stands disposed of
accordingly.

Since the application under Section 24
C.P.C. is being disposed of without hearing the
respondent, hence, he is at liberty to move
application for recall of this order, if he feels
aggrieved with the same.
